title: leeway.json
description: The leeway config: the catalogue of ports this repo's dev setup uses, plus the settings that apply to it.

$schema.description: The JSON schema this config follows; leeway ignores it.

ports.description: The catalogue: every port the dev setup uses, keyed by port name. Each port name is also the environment variable its port travels in.

propertyNames.description: A port name: letters, digits and _, not starting with a digit.

additionalProperties.description: A catalogue entry. Any properties besides port are yours; leeway ignores them.

port.description: The default port: the port this entry uses when no range applies.

agentGuard.description: Refuse default ports to agent shells that have no ports of their own.
